dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: You're back. Is there something I can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please help me tell my fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon also wants to know what sort of luck {NICKNAME}'ll have today!

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Hmm... From the pattern of the Spiritherbs' leaves... You will have good fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: You will find that fortune at the highest point in Watatsumi Island, in an ancient place dedicated to the gods.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... How come Paimon can't see any of that?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Hehe, this is what they call the wisdom of the local old folks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It sounds like you're just trying to bluff Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Oh, youngsters, how do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please help me tell my fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, what's our luck gonna be like today, hmm~?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: The Spiritherbs say that... you will have ill fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: You will have an ill-fated and unexpected encounter in a cave in the south of Watatsumi Island — a hive of scum and villainy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, it's bad luck! Uh, we should probably avoid that sort of place, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Hehe. However...

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Overcoming ill fate may yet bring you an unexpected boon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A boon...? You mean treasure? Is it gonna be treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: I did not say that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: But I did not say it wouldn't be that, either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, Granny, why do you have to be like that?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Hehe. Good luck cannot be rushed, and what's more, even Spiritherbs need rest.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Still, I'd like to thank you for coming by to say hello to an old lady. May you have safe travels.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Oh, youngsters, how do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please help me tell my fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wants to know what today will be like too!

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Hmm. The Spiritherbs say that this will be an ill-fated day.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: The ruined shrine in the east is shrouded in an ominous aura...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, that sounds kinda scary...

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: However...

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Those who boldly go forth and conquer such omens will receive their just reward.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This seems quite similar to what you said before...

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Ah, isn't life like that? New experiences always cloak themselves in familiar-seeming days.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Oh, youngsters, how do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please help me tell my fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, what's our luck gonna be like today, hmm~?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: The Spiritherbs say that... you will have good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: A gentle Electro Seelie will guide your path near the deep pool in the center of Watatsumi Island, just below the Sangonomiya Shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow!

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: It should be true. These divinations have always been very accurate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mmm, the more you say that, the more Paimon's getting suspicious...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't mind Paimon, Granny.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's alright, it's alright. You're still young...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wait a minute, what are you trying to say, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: "You will find that fortune at the highest point in Watatsumi Island, in an ancient place dedicated to the gods."

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: "A gentle Electro Seelie will guide your path near the deep pool in the center of Watatsumi Island, just below the Sangonomiya Shrine."

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: It will lead to unexpected good fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Oh, youngsters, how do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please help me tell my fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, is it gonna be good luck this time, Paimon wonders?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Oh dear, the Spiritherbs' light is rather weak at the moment. It seems they shall need some rest...

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: All the same, I can help you perform another divination.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Hmm. The twinkling of the Spiritherbs say that you shall have good fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: In the ruins to the northeast, in the ancient city that stands alone amidst the sea, a lingering spirit of mourning will light the way.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: However...

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: You must open for her a great gate and return her to her nest of sweet slumber before the fated reward can be yours.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was so confusing... Something something ancient city, something nest?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Haha, it's alright. I will remain here. If you cannot figure it out, you can feel free to ask me anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Is she calling Paimon stupid?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: "In the ruins to the northeast, in the ancient city that stands alone amidst the sea, a lingering spirit of mourning will light the way."

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: "Open for her a great gate and return her to her nest of sweet slumber, and the fated reward will be yours."

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: "You will have an ill-fated and unexpected encounter in a cave in the south of Watatsumi Island — a hive of scum and villainy."

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: "Yet overcoming that ill fate may bring you an unexpected boon."

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: "The ruined shrine in the east is shrouded in an ominous aura..."

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: "But should you boldly go forth and conquer such omens, you will receive your just reward."

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Haha, that's what the Spiritherbs say.
